sources.title: Security 51 Walkthrough — Day 1 to 14 (Level 1)
sources.version_boundary: Launch-build route observes the Day 6 Isolation Ward and early city-operation progression

claims.statement: Official sources confirm quarantine as a response to uncertain identity or humanity and acknowledge wrongful confinement.
Official sources confirm immediate and delayed consequences, damaged containment cells, infection spread, anomaly investigation, and city operations.
The observed launch route introduces elevator-camera threat selection, isolation, the Isolation Ward, and research on Day 6.
The observed early route connects ward research to city operations and shows that ward availability can change by day.

unknowns: No authoritative exact isolation or quarantine threshold for each ending was available.
The long-term outcome of every isolated subject remains branch-dependent and unverified.
A universal best research or city-operation order is not supported by the retained evidence.
